$comment: IMP-6 fixture: aws_volume_attachment is the id-divergent type — its discovery/import
id is `{Device}:{VolumeId}:{InstanceId}` while terraform-provider-aws stores a
SYNTHESIZED `vai-<hash>` as the state id. Both attachments below are `attached`, so
both reach the sweep; plan-sweep-happy.json manages exactly ONE of them. The managed
one must NOT be a finding (it used to be, on every sweep, forever) and the unmanaged
one MUST still be, which is what stops the fix from passing by suppressing the type.
Both VOLUMES are managed with plain ids, so the same capture file exercises a
plain-id match and a declared state_id_format match side by side.
